rulesList.name: Pet Policy
rulesList.content:
Must be kept on a leash and secured at all times.
All dogs must be licensed and up-to-date on vaccinations.
Doggy deposits must be cleaned up immediately. Waste baggies may be purchased from the campground store.
All pets must be attended, if left unattended they must be kept in your camper.
Any habitual barking dogs will be asked to be removed.
There is a $2/dog per day fee starting for the 2026 camping season. Dogs are not permitted on beach or in swimming area. No swimming in large fishing pond.

rulesList.name: Stop Signs
rulesList.content: You are required to stop at all STOP signs by the recreation building/office.

rulesList.name: Illness Onsite
rulesList.content: Anyone who has a communicable disease needs to notify the office personnel. This information will be kept strictly confidential.

rulesList.name: Trash Policy
rulesList.content: A trash dumpster is located near the exit gate for campground trash only. Trash may not be brought in from other places. Trash and litter including cigarette butts must be disposed of properly.

rulesList.name: Family Atmosphere
rulesList.content:
We maintain a family-oriented atmosphere. If you are wanting to get drunk and loud, this is NOT the place!
Alcoholic beverages are permitted if kept under control. All alcoholic beverages must be kept in a koozie at all times. No one under the age of 21 is permitted to have any alcoholic beverages while on the Back 40 Campground premises. Loud or profane language is not consistent with a good family atmosphere. So please refrain. RESPECT the privacy of other campers! DO NOT walk or drive across other camp sites.

rulesList.name: Prohibited Activities and Items
rulesList.content:
NO ILLEGAL DRUGS on Back 40 Campground premises. If caught, Police will be called, and you will be required to leave without refund. No cutting or trimming of trees.
No ATV's or dirt bikes allowed. . No vehicle washing of any kind including campers without prior approval from Back 40 Campground management.
The shower handles are spring loaded in order to conserve water, tying them down is prohibited. Do not ride bicycles after dark, for safety reasons.

Golf carts must be registered. There is a $5/day golf cart fee.

rulesList.name: Children
rulesList.content: Children under the age of 18 are not to be left at the campground unattended and must be at their campsite or accompanied by an adult at all times after 10:00 PM. Parents/guardians are responsible for damages to the Back 40 Campground/4D Outdoors Inc. or others' property by their children or visitors.

rulesList.name: Quiet Hours
rulesList.content: Quiet time is 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM. Be respectful of others wanting to sleep.

rulesList.name: Liability and Responsibility
rulesList.content: Back 40 Campground/4D Outdoors Inc./staff are not responsible for loss, damage, or claims for personal property, fire, theft, accident, or any other cause.

rulesList.name: Firearms and Fireworks
rulesList.content: Absolutely no fireworks, firearms, bows and arrows, or air powered weapons.

rulesList.name: Speed Limit
rulesList.content: Speed limit is 5MPH in the campground, no exceptions! Pedestrians have the right of way.

rulesList.name: Returned Checks
rulesList.content: There is a $20.00 charge on all returned checks, plus the bank fee.

rulesList.name: Messages
rulesList.content: Only emergency messages will be delivered.

rulesList.name: Recreational Building
rulesList.content:
Hours are as posted on door.
No one permitted behind the counter except for Back 40 Campground personnel.

rulesList.name: Refunds
rulesList.content: Refunds are granted on a case by case basis.

rulesList.name: Ponds
rulesList.content:
NO LIFEGUARDS ON DUTY. SWIM AT YOUR OWN RISK. ABSOLUTELY NO SWIMMING AFTER DARK.
Fishing is limited to north end of swimming pond.
Enjoy the campground and ponds, but please no littering.
All fish caught must be released back into pond, unless management approval.
Parents are responsible for their children & visitors in and around the ponds at all time.
Pets are not permitted to swim in the swimming pond.

rulesList.name: Sites
rulesList.content:
All litter, trash and cigarette butts must be placed in designated containers.
Do not move fire rings or picnic tables. Health Department regulations do not permit burning of any trash or litter in fire rings.
Sewage valve must be kept closed until dumped at dumping site, or dumped by Back 40 Campground personnel. Health Department regulations do not permit the draining of grey or black water on the ground or into open or unapproved containers.
Absolutely NO electric heaters, outside refrigerators, swimming pools, or any other item not camping related.
No overnight guest may put a tent up in your camping spot unless a camping registration is filled out and nightly camping fee paid.
Only 1 car per site at any time. Any visitors' vehicle must be parked at the visitors' parking lot adjacent to the recreation building.
When leaving camper, please turn off lights.
The occupancy of each site is limited to one camper or tent and a group of 5 (meaning 2 adults & 3 children) unless prior approval from management has been obtained.

rulesList.name: Check-In/Check-Out
rulesList.content: Check in is at 1:00 pm and check out is at noon.

rulesList.name: Registration & Fees
rulesList.content:
All visitors must pay and register at the office before entry. ANY guest not in your original group when you checked in is a visitor.
Daily visits are $5.00 per person except our Kids Trick or Treat Weekend in October and overnight visits are $5.00 per person. Those remaining after 10 PM will be charged as an overnight guest of $5.00 per person. Tenants are responsible for their guests.

info.whatToKnow: Kids Trick or Treat Weekend requires a one night non-refundable deposit the 2025 camping season.

rulesList.name: Guideline for an enjoyable stay
rulesList.content:
• Rates cover two people, one RV and one vehicle. Extra people and vehicles must be registered and paid for at the office. Site fees must be paid in advance no later than 11:00 am each day. No refunds for any reason.
• Check-in time is 12:00 noon. Check-out time is 11:00 am.
• Quiet Hours are 10:00 pm – 8:00 am.
• Speed Limit – 5 MPH.
• All sites must be kept clean and neat at all times. No large rugs on the grass.
• Laundry is open 24 hours. No clotheslines.
• Trash – All trash must be bagged and put into the park’s dumpster or a trash can.
• Water – Please conserve water. We have high water pressure and recommend a water pressure regulator. No washing of campers or vehicles in the park.
• Parents are responsible for children’s safety and behavior at all times while in campground, bathrooms and recreation areas. Children under 14 must not be left without parental supervision at any time.
• Fireworks - It is unlawful to discharge any form of fireworks on park property.
• No Parking on the Grass. No rugs or mats on the grass.
• Sewer hookups must be airtight.
• Trees – Do not chop down or use our trees for firewood. Firewood is available for sale at the General Store.
• No working on vehicles in the park. No ATV’s.
• Pets must be on a leash at all times and not be left unattended. Please clean up after your pets. Insurance does not allow outside fences or stakeout spikes.
• ANY PERSON WHO DEFACES OR DESTROYS PARK PROPERTY WILL BE HELD LIABLE FOR ITS FULL VALUE.
• We reserve the right to refuse anyone. We will immediately evict anyone publicly drunk, violating campground rules or creating any disturbance with no refund.

info.checkInProcedure:
Rifle Mountain Park
Campground Check-In Procedure
If you arrive during Host Cabin hours, you must check in at the Host Cabin before going to your campsite.

Host Cabin Hours:
Monday – Sunday: 12:00 PM – 3:00 PM
Thursday – Saturday: 6:00 PM – 8:00 PM

Check in Window:
Monday – Sunday: 1:00PM - 3:00PM 
Thursday – Saturday: 6:00 PM – 8:00 PM

During Host Cabin Hours:
1. Stop at the Host Cabin.
2. Provide your name and reservation confirmation.
3. Staff will verify your reservation and direct you to your assigned campsite.
4. Purchase a daily parking pass for each day of your visit to Rifle Mountain Park. Daily parking passes can be purchased at campground kiosks with cash/check or at the Host Cabin using a credit card. Visitors with a valid Annual Pass do not need to purchase a daily parking pass, as it covers day-use entry for the pass holder.
5. Display any required vehicle or site permit as instructed.


Arrivals Outside Host Cabin Hours
If you arrive outside of Host Cabin hours:
1. Enter the park.
2. Purchase a daily parking pass for each day of your visit to Rifle Mountain Park. Daily parking passes can be purchased at campground kiosks with cash/check or at the Host Cabin using a credit card. Visitors with a valid Annual Pass do not need to purchase a daily parking pass, as it covers day-use entry for the pass holder.
3. Proceed directly to your assigned campsite listed in your RoverPass confirmation.
4. Set up only within your designated campsite boundaries.
5. Be prepared to verify your reservation with staff the following day if requested.

Because there is no cell service, you must have your reservation confirmation downloaded, printed, or saved prior to arrival.

Please note: An Annual Pass covers day-use only and does not include camping fees.

rulesList.name: PERMITS & STAY LIMITS
rulesList.content:

Additional vehicles are not allowed. - Campsites labeled “Van” are for camper vans or vehicle camping only. Van sites are limited to one vehicle only. Visitors with a valid Annual Pass do not need to purchase a Daily Parking Pass, as it covers day-use entry for the pass holder.

Please note: Annual Passes cover day-use only and does not include camping fees.

rulesList.name: Campground Rules
rulesList.content: We are excited that you are considering a stay at Sweet Minihaha Campground. We have a lot of fun here but we have some rules that must be followed to ensure everyone's good time and safety while staying with us. Please review our rules below.

rulesList.name: 1. ALL CAMPERS AND VISITORS MUST BE REGISTERED
rulesList.content:
Wristbands will be issued and MUST be worn while on the premises. This includes ANYONE using our landing. Without a wristband, you are considered trespassing.

Camping Fees are per unit. One family per unit. (2 adults and their 2 minor children) All campers are responsible for their guests. Only 2 cars per site, overflow parking available. 2 night minimum stay on weekends.

rulesList.name: 2. CHECK OUT TIME
rulesList.content: Check-out time is 11:00 AM. Please leave your site clean. CHECK IN TIME: Noon

rulesList.name: 3. QUIET HOUR
rulesList.content: Quiet hour is 10:30 PM on weekdays and 11:00 PM on weekends. All noise must be held to a minimum for those campers who wish to rest. All radios, stereos, etc, are to be shut OFF at 11:00 PM. This includes generators. Anyone causing a disturbance or damaging property will be vacated from the property.

rulesList.name: 4. FIRES
rulesList.content: Clean fires are permitted in fire rings only. NO GARBAGE. Please do not move fire rings . Please do not leave fires unattended. No cutting of trees, etc in campground. Firewood CANNOT be brought from more than 10 miles from the campground. Please see DNR regulations for more information. We selll firewood for $10 a wheelbarrow full on premises.

rulesList.name: 5. PETS
rulesList.content: Pets must be kept on a leash at all times. Please do not leave pets unattended. Please clean up after your pets! Only TWO pets per site. Pets are not allowed in the restrooms. We will not tolerate barking dogs.

rulesList.name: 6. CHILDREN
rulesList.content: Adults are responsible for their children. Minor children should be at their campsites by 10:00 PM. Please do not leave your children at the campground unattended. Parks close at dusk.

rulesList.name: 7. SPEED LIMITS
rulesList.content: Speed limit is 5 miles per hour in the campground.

rulesList.name: 8. TRASH
rulesList.content: Dumpsters are provided at the exit of the campground. Please help us out by using the dumpsters. One is for recyclables, one is for garbage. Please keep campsite neat and clean. Please recycle. We will not accept refuse if it is not sorted. You may co-mingle recyclables.

rulesList.name: 9. FISHING
rulesList.content: You need a Wisconsin fishing license to fish the Sugar River. All DNR regulations as far as size and lengths of fish should be observed. Please put garbage from fish in plastic bags and place in the dumpster.

rulesList.name: 10. MOTORIZED VEHICLES
rulesList.content: No mopeds, mini bikes, dirt bikes, 4 wheelers, etc are allowed. Motorcycles can be used as transportation to and from the campground. Please observe our quiet times.

rulesList.name: 11. FIREARMS
rulesList.content: Absolutely no firearms, illegal fireworks, etc allowed in the campground.

rulesList.name: 12. INSURANCE
rulesList.content: It is mandatory that you have insurance on your unit.

rulesList.name: 13. GOLF CARTS
rulesList.content:
Only one golf cart per site. Only persons with a valid state drivers license will be allowed to operate the golf cart. Please limit the number of passengers to the number of seats on the cart. Speed Limit is 5 MPH.

​

rulesList.name: 14. ENFORCEMENT
rulesList.content: This will be done in equity. Serious offenders will be asked to remove their units and belongings from the property known as Sweet Minihaha Campground

rulesList.name: PLEASE BE AWARE THAT THE MANAGEMENT AND OWNERS OF THE PARK ARE NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR LOSS DUE TO FIRE, THEFT, ACCIDENTS, FLOODS, ETC.
YOU ARE THE MOST IMPORTANT PEOPLE TO US. IF YOU HAVE A PROBLEM TELL US. IF YOU HAD AN ENJOYABLE TIME. TELL A FRIEND!  A DETAILED LIST OF ALL RATES AND RULES IS LOCATED IN THE OFFICE.

rulesList.name: NO SMOKING IN CAMPGROUND BUILDINGS
rulesList.content: Do not throw cigarette butts on the ground anywhere in the campground. They can take up to 10 years to decompose, and we’d like to keep our property clean for others to enjoy. Dispose of cigarette butts in a tin can.

rulesList.name: CAMPGROUND MAINTENANCE
rulesList.content: Each site has a picnic table and a fire ring. Firewood will be available for purchase. Gas/Charcoal Grills may be used for cooking on your site. Avoid cooking on tables. Dispose cool ashes safely and properly. Do not use grill/campfires in times of extreme fire danger or high winds. Do not litter your site. Pick up after yourselves.

rulesList.name: PETS
rulesList.content: (2) Dogs are allowed per site with no extra charge. Because we love our dogs, Fireworks are not allowed at the campground. Keep in mind that there are many kinds of wildlife in the area that have caused the best of trained dogs to run off. Unruly, noisy, or aggressive dogs will be cause for eviction. Pets must be on a leash and with owner at all times while outdoors. They are not to be tied up and left unattended while owner is away. Owners are responsible for PICKING UP after their pets in all area of the campground and disposing of their waste. Waste must be sealed in dog bags and thrown in trash.

rulesList.name: SEWER & WASTE
rulesList.content: Sewer hoses MUST HAVE a 90-degree threaded elbow to attach to your site’s sewer drain. A dynoster is located nect to the shower/laundry building. Household garbage only, and must be tied securely in garbage bags before thrown away. NO FISH ENTRAILS ALLOWED IN DUMPSTER. You may clean your fish at the lake or at the fish cleaning station located south of the boat landing at the foot of Big Stone Lake, in Ortonville. Recycling of aluminium isn’t required, but a collection barrel for pop/beer cans is located next to the dumpster, and are donated to schools in Big Stone City.

rulesList.name: PARKING
rulesList.content: Parking of boats, extra cars, or visitor cars must be parked in the grassy area on either end of the campground. Please do not park extra vehicles on or near your site as that can cause damage to underground pipes and line. Your boat is allowed on your site when charging your battery only. Please avoid driving over and parking in vacant spots.

rulesList.name: RATES
rulesList.content: Rates are based on (2) adults or LESS per site. Visitors of our guests who spend the day or night are required to contact the camp hosts and pay $5/ea per adult for use of campground facilities. registered guests must be present with all visitors. NO sub-renting or loaning of your RV or site is allowed. Sites are assigned on Roverpass with given information to assign correct spots. Discounts for military, law enforcement, firemen/women, & EMT’s. Rate includes full hook-up of water, electricity, and sewer for your RV, and parking of the one vehicle that tows it. Extra vehicles and boats are not part of your site. No charging of electric vehicles at this campgound. Boat batteries may be charged at your site.

info.campgroundCancellationPolicy: 100% refund until 3 days prior to check-in. 50% percent refund 1 day prior, then the reservation is non-refundable.
info.checkInProcedure: We are a self-service campground and do not require campers to check-in upon arrival, as all sites with electricity require prepaid reservations.  If arriving without a reservation, please check Roverpass.com for site availability before setting up camp in spots N1-N10 or W1-W10.  Primitive camping (on grass) is available first come first served with payment slips available at the showerhouses. If you need assistance or have questions during your stay, please call or text 701-680-3736.  Although rare, we may need to move you from your originally booked campsite to a nearby site and if so - we will communicate prior to your arrival.

rulesList.name: RESERVED SPOTS
rulesList.content: Sandager Park will make every attempt to keep your original campsite spot that you reserved, however, there may be circumstances where you may need to be moved. If so, communication will be sent to you prior to your arrival letting you know your new campsite spot.

rulesList.name: GROUP RESERVATIONS
rulesList.content: Please contact the park at 701-680-3736 if interested in blocking off an entire campground for a set time frame for a large group reservation.

rulesList.name: PRIMITIVE CAMPING
rulesList.content: Online reservations are not available/required for primitive campsites. $10 per night, payment envelopes available at information boards. Campers and tents on grass must be moved every 72 hours.

rulesList.name: FIREWOOD
rulesList.content: Firewood is available for campground guests; $1 per log with payment envelopes available.

rulesList.name: DIRECTIONS
rulesList.content:
To access the West Campground (full hookup) please enter from 2nd Ave onto Parkway Drive which is a dead end road.

To access the North Campground (electric only) please enter from 2nd Ave, turning north onto Oak Street then turning west onto Parkway Drive. You will turn right at the Brown building and the campground is on the north side of the FEMA dike.

rulesList.name: CANCELLATIONS
rulesList.content: Cancellations must go through the RoverPass platform; no cancellations will be taken over the phone.

rulesList.name: GARBAGE
rulesList.content: Please help keep our campground beautiful by bagging all garbage and placing it directly in the dumpsters during and at the end of your stay.

rulesList.name: QUIET HOURS
rulesList.content: Quiet hours are 11pm to 7am. Please be courteous to other campers and control excessive noise at all other times as well.

rulesList.name: PROPERTY DAMAGE
rulesList.content: Damage to park property of any kind might result in removal of individual or entire camping party from park property, charge for damage, repair, or clean-up costs and/or notification of law enforcement.

rulesList.name: CAMPFIRES
rulesList.content: Campfires must always be attended and are restricted to fire rings/pits as placed by park staff. No trash, metal or plastic is to be burned or left in fire pits.

rulesList.name: PET POLICY
rulesList.content: Pets are welcome in the park but must be kept on a leash at all times. You are also required to clean up after your pet.

rulesList.name: RV's

rulesList.name: Pets

rulesList.name: Vehicles

rulesList.name: Storage

rulesList.name: Repairs

rulesList.name: Responsibility

rulesList.name: Failure to Enforce is not a Waiver:
rulesList.content:
The failure of Hidden Acres Management to enforce at any time any provision of these rules shall in no way be construed to be a waiver of any of the rules listed above.
As the name recreational vehicle implies, all rigs must be mobile and easy to move in the event of an emergency or at the request of management. My signature below indicates my understanding and my agreement to abide by all rules listed on page 1 and 2 of the Hidden Acres Rules along with the notices listed on the Hidden Acres camping agreement.

rulesList.name: Refusal of Services:
rulesList.content: We reserve the right to refuse service to anyone at any time. Any rights granted to overnight visitors in the park is through a revocable license, which may be revoked at any time. Under no circumstances should you consider yourself a tenant with a lease.

rulesList.name: Theft of Service Law.
rulesList.content:
You may NOT assign or sublet your site. According to Texas Penal Code Section 31:04 (b), any guest who leaves without paying for site services or who refuses to pay for site services when due is subject to criminal prosecution. We are providing service hook-ups for your RV. We require full payment
in advance and will prosecute any violations under the "THEFT OF SERVICES LAW. You are NOT under a landlord/tenant arrangement.

rulesList.name: Payments/Late Payments/Returned Checks:
rulesList.content: Fees not paid by noon on the last day of previous camping period is subject to $15.00 per day thereafter. Returned checks will result in a $35.00 handling fee, the late fee described until full payment is received by cashier's check or money order. Future payments will be required to be credit card or certified funds. Cash is not accepted. Please plan accordingly.

rulesList.name: Mail and Package delivery
rulesList.content: is not permitted for campers at Hidden Acres RV Park. Good alternatives are Escapees and local post office boxes.

rulesList.name: Loaning of tools:
rulesList.content: Our insurance policy does not permit loaning of tools. Please do not ask.

rulesList.name: Damages
rulesList.content: Registered camper(s) will be responsible for any damages directly or indirectly caused by any of their campers, minors or guests. Fees will include all necessary replacement parts and repair Labor will be billed at a minimum of $25.00 per person per hour. Emergency and holiday repairs will be billed at a minimum of $40.00 per person per hour. Specialty repairs may result in higher costs. Campers will not be permitted to make or arrange for repairs to park.

rulesList.name: Cancellations
rulesList.content:
We view a reservation as a "two-way" agreement. We agree to hold the space which you have reserved, turning away all further requests, in return for your payment. Refunds will be only as follows: Daily Reservations: Cancellations made greater than 7 days or more prior to scheduled check-in are subject to a penalty equal to one (1) day reservation fee. No refunds for reservations canceled less than 6 days prior to your scheduled date of arrival. Weekly and Monthly Reservations: The reservation deposit for a weekly/monthly reservation converts to an electrical deposit upon check-in and is refundable minus any outstanding fees.
The reservation deposit is non-refundable if check-in does not occur on the scheduled date or if the reservation is canceled. No refunds for early departures, late arrivals, inclement weather, power outages, or acts of nature.

rulesList.name: Behavior/Public intoxication & illegal drugs:
rulesList.content: Illegal drugs, public intoxication, violence, the threat of violence, loud obnoxious, disorderly, boisterous, unlawful conduct or conduct that disturbs or threatens the rights, comfort, or convenience of others will not be tolerated under any circumstances and may result in the notification of police and immediate notice to vacate without any refund of fees paid.

rulesList.name: Firearms & Fireworks:
rulesList.content: Discharging fireworks and Firearms are not permitted anywhere on the property. Displaying, discharging or possessing a gun, knife or other weapon in any way that may alarm others is not allowed and doing so WILL result in immediate requirement to vacate the premises without refund of camping fees.

rulesList.name: Smoking Prohibited:
rulesList.content: Smoking inside the Office or Laundry Room is strictly prohibited.

rulesList.name: Trailers and Boats:
rulesList.content: Trailers not being used as a camping unit and boats may accompany a camping unit on site. The trailer and or boat will be counted as (1) *other unit" and must be kept within the perimeter of the site.

rulesList.name: Disposal of Trash:
rulesList.content: All trash/garbage must be in trash bags and tied before being deposited in trash containers at the site. Failure to do so may result in a $25.00 per occurrence correction/handling fee by park staff.

rulesList.name: Decking and Skirting:
rulesList.content: Decking or skirting that is erected or attached in any way other than snaps (no missing snaps) is not permitted. Decks are permitted only if prior written consent is obtained trom park management.

rulesList.name: Campsite Cleanliness and Appearance:
rulesList.content:
Campsite cleanliness is required for aesthetic, sanitary and safety purposes. Your site must be kept litter free--including
cigarette butts. Decorations for holidays are permitted as long as they are not disruptive to other campers and are within the site perimeters and removed within 10 days after the holiday. Items that are permitted at assigned campsites include: barbeque, bikes, lawn chairs, and camping related equipment. Straw Bale Gardens,
clotheslines, storage under Camping Unit is prohibited. Portable camp awnings without sides or with net sides are permitted. (No tarp created sides) You are
responsible for any and all damage that may be caused by your awning to neighboring units. Staking and digging into the grass and gravel is not permitted.
Please remember that we have electric, water and septic lines buried thru out the park. It is at the discretion of the Park staff to determine whether or not a
campsite is in compliance. DO NOT MAKE ANY CHASES TO THE RV SITE WITHOUT PRIOR WRITTEN CONSENT FROM MANAGEMENT.

rulesList.name: Operation of Business:
rulesList.content: The operation of a business on the RV Site or on the Property is prohibited.

rulesList.name: Notice to Vacate:
rulesList.content:
Park Management reserves the right to refuse camping to anyone and to have any camper or guest removed with or without prior notice for
violation of rules, stated here or published thereafter. Failure to comply with a demand to depart may result in violation of trespassing laws and towing of camping
unit at the campers expense without liability to Hidden Acres for any secondary damage to unit. If any person refuses to vacate the premises, the police dept. shall
remove them prior to the removal of the Camping Unit. Notice of the removal including the name, address and phone number of the towing/storage facility would be
posted at the camp site and/or at the Park office. Signing of these Campground rules indicates your authorization for the (park management) to remove the
RV/Trailer (camping unit) and contents to a licensed storage facility at camper's expense for failure to vacate when requested to do so. This request may be a result
of and or nonpayment of camping fees.

rulesList.name: Payments, Extending a Stay, Late Pay and retumed payment Fee:
rulesList.content:
All fees are to be paid prior to connecting. Payment to extend a stay must be made prior to
9am on the expected departure date. Weekly and monthly campers are advised to reserve their next stay as soon as possible. Acceptance of extension will be
based upon availability. Hidden Acres cannot guarantee availability until payment is received. A late payment charge will be accrued when camping/electricity fee
has not been paid by the due date/time. Partial payment acceptance is at the discretion of management. Partial payments will not delay the accrual of late fees.
Late fee is $15.00 per day. Any site that is occupied 24 hours without written arrangements from management may have utilities disconnected and immediate action
may be taken under the trespassing laws. A return or cancellation of any payment will result in a $35.00 fee and a $15.00 late fee for each day that the payment is
late.

rulesList.name: RV Policy
rulesList.content: Camping Rates include 6 campers per site. Add $2 per day for additional campers.

rulesList.name: Change Policy
rulesList.content:
Service charges may apply for changes to this reservation. One change to reservation is allowed without incurring a service charge; all subsequent
changes will be charged $5.00 per change.

rulesList.name: Camping Fee Payment Policy:
rulesList.content:
A payment of 100% of reservation fee is required at the time of booking. Cash is not accepted. Payments by check, money
order or bank check are accepted. Credit Card payments via the QuickBooks invoicing payment system will result in a 3% on-line service charge. By
providing a credit card number, you are authorizing Hidden Acres to bill your credit card for the full amount of reservation, including any costs accrued at the property,
and outstanding balances not paid at the time of departure. Long Term campers will be invoiced monthly payment is due by noon on the last day of the current
reservation period.

rulesList.name: Electrical
rulesList.content:
Campers acknowledge that they connect to park electrical sources at their own risk. Hidden Acres is not liable for damage or injury that occurs either
directly or indirectly relating to electricity. Surge protectors are strongly encouraged.

rulesList.name: Septic/Sewer:
rulesList.content:
Only use non-formaldehyde products and septic system approved toilet tissue. Feminine Hygiene products, diapers, paper towels etc. are to be
discarded in trash cans only. Campers will be held financially responsible for damage to septic system as a result of pouring chemicals or non-biodegradable
products of any type into system. (If in doubt, do NOT pour it down the drain. Notify the office and we will be happy to discard it for you). A sewer hose "donut' or "L°
connector is required at all times. Please be considerate of hair waste and make every effort to place in trash instead of allowing to flow into the septic system.

rulesList.name: Fires in Campground:
rulesList.content:
Fires are only permitted in commercially purchased BBQ/Smoker units and may only be used for cooking purposes. These units must be
used and stored at assigned campsites only. Ground fires are never permitted. Campsite fire pits are allowed on gravel only with intact screen covers used at all
times-FIRES ARE TO BE PUT OUT IF WIND SPEEDS ARE GREATER THAN 15MPH. All coals must be cooled/moistened and disposed of in cans. Coals are not
to be dumped on the ground and lives coals must not be placed in trash cans.

rulesList.name: Pets in Campground:
rulesList.content:
Pets must be registered at the Park Office. Dogs must be kept on a 10-foot maximum leash. Current vaccination documentation must be
readily available upon request. Dogs that are on the "Viscous Breed List', that snarl, growl, bark, snap, bite and/or are noisy are not allowed. Dogs may not be left
unattended outside of camping unit, left outside overnight and may not enter park buildings. Staking or "tying up' outside is not permitted at any time. Dogs must be
cleaned up after immediately. A $25.00 fine will be assessed per violation. More than 3 fines will result in a required departure.

rulesList.name: Vehicles in Campground and Repairs/Maintenance of vehicles:
rulesList.content:
The following is not permitted: operation of a vehicle to create excessive noise or markings,
repairs or maintenance. Flat tire and battery jumping is permitted with a 2 hour time limit for repair. Washing of camping unit is encouraged once every 3 months.
When washing unit please use landscaping safe soap, do not create a hazard or disturbance to others. Vehicles must be intact and have current legal registrations.
Vehicles are not to have missing fenders, fairings, doors, broken windows, etc.

rulesList.name: Entry, Exit and Speed Limits:
rulesList.content:
Park entry and exit routes are to be used as designated. Speed limit within Campground is 5 mph at all times. Failure to maintain
speed may result in being required to vacate the premises without refund of camping fees. PARKING AND DRIVING ON GRASS IS NOT PERMITTED.

rulesList.name: Overnight Sleeping is prohibited outside of camping unit.
rulesList.content: This includes in tents and vehicles parked on your site.

rulesList.name: Campground "Quiet time":
rulesList.content: A period of quiet time" shall be observed in the campground area between the hours of 10:00p & 8:00a. During this time period, noise and other disturbing activities will not be allowed.

rulesList.name: Minors and Guests:
rulesList.content:
Minors are not allowed to register for a campsite and must be accompanied by a registered camper at all times. Minors are required to be
within their campsite by 10:00 p.m. and within their camping unit by midnight. Registered Campers are responsible for all conduct and safety of, or damage caused by any accompanying minors, adult and minor guests. Under no circumstances are minors under the age of 13 to be left unattended during daylight hours. Minors under the age of 16 are not to be left unattended during night hours. Minors are not to operate any motorized carts, bike or vehicles while on the property. If authorities (police) are called as a result of a disturbance at your site. You will be required to vacate the park within 24 hours without refund of camping
fees.

rulesList.name: Campsite Occupancy:
rulesList.content:
Each campsite is limited to (1) camping unit and (2) additional units (vehicles/motorcycles/trailers etc.). Guests are to park at your site. If
you need assistance with extra parking please contact us and we will do what we can to assist if possible. Parking on the grass is not ever permitted. Parking
on the grass may result in camper being assessed a fee to repair the damage to landscaping.

rulesList.name: Unit Requirement:
rulesList.content:
Park Staff will perform an inspection periodically, during course of stay. Current campers at Hidden Acres on 5.1.20 will be grand fathered in
and permitted to stay as previously approved. We ask that campers do their very best to become and stay compliant when able to do so. Camping unites older than
15 years old are only accepted by individual approval by management. The following items may result in camping not being permitted or a *request to repair or
vacate"; damage to the exterior of the unit, broken windows, leaks, missing panels, dents, rust holes, mold, mildew, exposed wiring, missing components,
offensive/unsightly graphics, tires that are not inflated completely and/or flat, makeshift repairs using tape, tarps and/or other materials not factory installed, unable to be relocated on own power or tow vehicle not available at all times, units that are not self-contained, all trailer tongues or hitches must be in working order and un-locked, 30/50 amp electrical plug from the RV must be in safe working condition, connections free of calcium build-up or corrosion and also be UL certified. Warped or melted plugs or protective sheath damage will not be acceptable, sewage lines must have proper flanges and connections with no leakage, sewer hose must be inserted into the drain with a plastic elbow or rubber donut only, Waste Tank Emptying Valve Handles are to remain closed & only opened to be emptied. Window AC, Fans and tarps are only permitted if preapproved by management. The camping unit must be positioned straight on the site and connections on the same side of the parks utility connections.

rulesList.content:
Check-In Time: 1pm, Checkout Time: 11am. Campers desiring to check-in early or checkout late may do so, depending upon availability
and by paying an early "check in* fee of $5.00 per hour. Late "checkout fee is $5.00 per hour if pre-arranged. Late checkout fee is $5.00 per each 15 mins if not pre-
arranged by scheduling before 9am on day of scheduled departure.

rulesList.name: Pet Policy
rulesList.content:
Small pets are allowed, but must be kept on a leash when outside.
Please clean up after your pet. Do not chain pets outside. Pet owners must comply with all applicable state and local laws and ordinances, and shall confine pets to Tenant’s RV space. All pets must accompany Tenants when they leave Kountry Ranch RV Park and at no time may be left unattended. Tenant shall remove pet from Kountry Ranch RV Park upon demand in the event that said pet shall, in any way, disturb other tenants.

rulesList.name: Trash
rulesList.content: Please do not throw cigarette butts on ground. Trash cans are easily accessible.

rulesList.name: RV Sites
rulesList.content: All Sites have full hookups. All rigs must be self contained. Do not connect 50 amps to 30 amp service.

rulesList.name: No Sub-leasing
rulesList.content: Subleasing of RV is not allowed under any circumstances.

rulesList.name: Washing RVs
rulesList.content: No car or RVs washing with RV Park water is allowed.

rulesList.name: Quiet Hours
rulesList.content: Quiet time is between 10 p.m. to 8 a.m.

rulesList.name: Site Appearance
rulesList.content: Tenants shall have the use of assigned overnight space site for one recreation vehicle and one additional vehicle. Temporary fences, walls, poles, signs, barriers, excessive ornaments, clothes lines or any structures of any kind are prohibited.

info.name: Lake Point RV Resort
info.campgroundCancellationPolicy: 100% refund until 7 days prior to check-in. 50% percent refund 3 days prior, then 2 days prior the reservation is no longer refundable.
info.checkInProcedure:
We welcome you to the City of Valley View and Lake Point RV Resort.  We are here to help you in any way we can.  Please feel free to call the office as you see needs.

Office:
You may call the office at any time During Business Hours. Follow the necessary prompts as needed. Please leave a message if it is not an emergency and we will follow up the next business day as needed. The office number is:  940-637-1021.
If there is a medical emergency or police are needed dial 911 and the local authorities will arrive. If the emergency is park related please call;  940-637-1000.

The following items are for your reference and use while staying here.

Community Center:
The Community Center is available during the hours of 7am until 9pm seven days a week, year-round.  In times of weather emergency, the facility will be opened for your use and discretion.  Please be aware others may be in the facility at the same time.  All areas, internal and external, are under recorded video surveillance for your safety.

Restrooms:
During normal Community Center hours, the restrooms (total 4) are available for your use.  They are full service (showers, toilets, and sinks).  These are available 24 hours a day unless under service.  If it is after Center hours, there is an outside entry.  Use the provided access code for exterior entry.  Please make sure the outside door closes completely for your safety.  All restrooms have individual locks. There are no bathing supplies provided. Paper products are provided.  If they need servicing, please let the office know.  To exit the exterior door, the thumb knob will need to be turned.  The door will automatically lock behind you after 15 seconds.
These facilities are used by your fellow campers, please be responsible and clean up after yourself. THANK YOU!

Laundry Room:
The laundry room (located on the main roadside) is accessed from outside the building and will require the access code provided.  The laundry room is available 24 hours.  To exit the exterior door, the thumb knob will need to be turned.  The door will automatically lock behind you after 15 seconds. The machines use the “Pay Range” app.  Coins or credit cards are not required.  There are directions in the laundry room to setup the app and machine access.  Connect to the internet while there for ease.

After Hours Restroom/Laundry Access Code: 2024

Internet Access:
Each site has streaming internet available.  The connection via Cat 5 or Cat 6 cable is at the back of each pedestal.  You will need an internet router to communicate.  The Internet is free and does not require an account or set up (except for the router).  If you need help with this, please let us know.

Wireless WiFi is available at the common space in the Community Center and Laundry areas.
WiFi ID:  Lake Point RV Guest
Password:  3100efm922

rulesList.name: Winter Weather Advisory
rulesList.content:
Winter Weather preparedness:

The following is a required step to be taken when a freeze warning has been announced by the local weather authority as well posted by signs at the Lake Point RV Resort.

When temperatures are to fall below freezing for multiple days and the Lake Point office has posted the “Freeze Warning” sign out, the water supply provided at each site by Lake Point RV is to be turned off at the hose bib and not used unless refilling your freshwater tank and the outside temperature is above freezing for the day.

Lake Point RV Resort nor its affiliates are liable nor responsible physically or financially for weather-related damage to personal property.

rulesList.name: Community Center Access and Use
rulesList.content: The Community Center and facilities are available for all customers to use. Please respect others while using them. The Center hours of use are from 7am until 9pm unless special events or accommodations have been made with the office. Children 12 and under must be accompanied by a parent. Shirt and shoes are required when inside the facilities. No smoking or vaping in or around the immediate vicinity of the center.

rulesList.name: Background Check
rulesList.content: Your safety and security are our top priority. All prospective guests who plan to stay longer than 30 days will be subject to a criminal background check. The results of the background check are considered on a case-by-case basis. Your background check results will be kept confidential and will be performed by a third-party company.

rulesList.name: Parking
rulesList.content: Sites have room for 2 vehicles. No parking on grass or in the empty sites. No cargo trailers of any kind allowed in sites. Overflow parking may be available upon request. Unauthorized vehicles will be towed at owners expense.

rulesList.name: Speed Limit
rulesList.content: All guests will adhere to a 5 mph speed limit that is strictly enforced.

rulesList.name: Trash
rulesList.content: Place all bagged trash in the dumpster. No furniture, mattresses, appliances or large items.

rulesList.name: RV Policy
rulesList.content: All RV’s must be fully operational RV’s older than ten years must be approved by management prior to arrival. RV appearance must be well kept clean and neat. Window coverings must not be cardboard, wood, tin foil or uncommon window coverings. Coverings and awnings must be in good condition with no rips or tears. During the winter months Lakepoint RV Resort requires campers staying more than 1 week to have a heated water hose. All RV’s entering the Park must have empty holding tanks.

rulesList.name: Quiet Hours
rulesList.content: Quiet hours are 10:00 pm to 7:00 am. There will only be one warning for the violation of quiet hours.

rulesList.name: RV Sites
rulesList.content: RV sites must be kept clean and tidy. Patio furniture, bbq grills and portable satellite dishes are allowed. Everything kept on the site must be able to be moved by landscaping crews. No rugs on grass. There could be up to a $150 charge for any items abandoned on site. A $50 clean up fee will be applied to monthly invoices when dog waste is not cleaned up regularly. Do not drive or push anything into the ground without management approval. Absolutely no clothesline/ hanging laundry, outside appliances including window AC units, hot tubs or pools.

rulesList.name: Police
rulesList.content: We have a zero-tolerance policy involving police. If police respond to the resort for anything other than a medical emergency, you will be asked to leave immediately with no refund at the discretion of Lakepoint RV Resort owners and managers.

rulesList.name: Pets
rulesList.content: Friendly pets are welcome! Please pick up after your pets and keep them on a leash when walking throughout the park. Each site is permitted 2 pets. Pets cannot be left outside when you are not on site. Nuisance barking will not be permitted. We enforce zero tolerance of aggressive pets.

rulesList.name: Laundry
rulesList.content: Laundry facilities are open 24/7, please be respectful of others when washing and don’t leave laundry unattended.

rulesList.name: Fires
rulesList.content: No open fires are permitted on premises.

rulesList.name: Water
rulesList.content: No outside watering except for potted plants. No vehicle or RV washing.

rulesList.name: Children
rulesList.content: Children must be monitored and accompanied by an adult when playing outside or within the community center and facilities. Please go over campground etiquette with them if they are new to staying at an RV resort.

rulesList.name: Lawn Maintenance
rulesList.content: We ask that guests make sure their area is clear of all debris, outdoor furniture and pet waste so crews can maintain the lawn.

rulesList.name: Internet
rulesList.content: Wifi is complimentary to all guests at the community center. Hardwired high speed internet is available at each site.

rulesList.name: Sewer
rulesList.content: An airtight sewer connection is required at all times. Leaks in a sewage system must be repaired or replaced immediately. If not, the park will assume this responsibility at a cost to the guest. There will be a minimum charge of $50 for raw sewage cleanup. Lakepoint RV Park is on a septic system. No plastic items, condoms, tampon dispensers, straws.

rulesList.name: Indemnity and waiver of liability
rulesList.content:
Customers shall indemnify and hold Lakepoint RV Resort harmless from and against any and all claims, demands, costs, expenses, water, wind, civil strife, or acts of God, actions or indications
of other customers, guests, invitees or licensee of customer or any other customer actions or inactions (or those of their employees, agents or invitees), or any other causes related to customer’s use or occupation of the RV site. The management assumes no responsibility for accidents, injuries or loss from any cause.

rulesList.name: Rights
rulesList.content:
Lakepoint RV Resort reserves the right to refuse service at any time and to have a guest vacated from the park property in the event of inappropriate behavior or infraction of this agreement without refund. The Owner & Management reserve the right to amend, to revise, & add to the rules & guidelines at any time.
Under Texas law, you are not a tenant with a lease or contract. Anyone who fails to comply with these rules that benefit everyone will be asked to leave with no refund. (Texas Penal Code 30.05)
Any guest who leaves without paying for site services or refuses to pay for site services when due, is subject to criminal prosecution. Lakepoint RV Resort is providing service hook-ups for tenant’s RV. Full payment is required in advance & any violations will be prosecuted under the “THEFT OF SERVICES LAW”. (TEXAS PENAL CODE 31:04)

rulesList.name: Respect

rulesList.name: Smoking

rulesList.name: Pet Rules
rulesList.content: Pets are certainly welcome. However, all pets must be under physical control by the owner / handler at all times! Do not leave pets outside unattended. Please do not allow your pets to disturb other campers or go into their camp site. When taking your pets to relieve themselves only use the large grassy area past the back row away from camp sites and stored vehicles / campers. If you pet goes on another's site please clean it up it is not up to other visitors or camp staff to pick up after your pet.

rulesList.name: Speed Limit

rulesList.name: Quiet Hours

rulesList.name: Visitors

rulesList.name: Cleanliness

Please do not flush any feminine hygiene products, diapers or anything other than toilet paper down the toilets. Or pour grease down your drains in your sinks or our bathroom sinks. This causes septic system backups. For cost for washing vehicles or boats please check with the office.

rulesList.name: Monthly Renters

rulesList.name: Preserve Rule Book
rulesList.content:
Please refer to rule book at Welcome Center when entering.
The maximum speed limit is 20 mph unless posted otherwise.
Adult supervision is required: Children 12 and under must be accompanied by an adult at all times at the pools, lakes, beach, and river.
Transporting children in the open back of a pickup truck is not permitted.
Lincoln Pool is an "Adults Only Pool". No one under 21 is permitted.
No food, beverage, tobacco products or pets are allowed inside the pool areas with the exception of nonalcoholic drinks in the plastic containers.
No glass containers are permitted within 100 feet of the swimming pools.
No animals, poultry, or farm animals, other than household pets, shall be maintained on any lot or in the Preserve.
No loose dogs, cats, or other pets are permitted. Pets must be penned or leashed. Animal owners are solely responsible for the actions of their pets while on any portion of the Preserve, whether common areas or a privately owned lot.
Pet waste must be removed immediately from common ground areas and along streets.
No parking is permitted on a neighbor's or vacant lot, including the blocking of any driveway at any time.
Inoperable vehicles are not permitted and must be moved within 48 hours of notice to remove the vehicle.
Any vehicle accident caused by a POA member or guest, or by their vehicle, is the sole responsibility of the driver and/or owner of the vehicle.
ATV's, Four-Wheelers, & UTV's are prohibited.
Campfires are confined to designated areas only.
Exterior clotheslines are prohibited.
Fireworks are not permitted.
Profane language, drunkenness, abusive or threatening behavior, illegal activities, property damage, speeding, driving while intoxicated or overly medicated, drugs or immoral conduct, as defined by state and local laws are not tolerated at any time.
Trash must be securely bagged.
No hunting or trapping is permitted on the property.
Discharging of firearms is prohibited.
Quiet time in the Preserve is from 10 pm to daybreak, seven days a week, and amenities are closed during this period.
Soliciting is prohibited.
Tents are prohibited.
All applicable state and federal Rules and Regulations apply to fishing within the Preserve.
Fishing is allowed only by rod and reel or other pole and line methods.
Bow fishing is prohibited.
Catch and Release for BASS only.
Pontoon boats, kayaks, and canoes are permitted on the lakes in the Preserve provided they are no more than 18 feet in length.
Only electric trolling motors are allowed for use in the lakes and ponds of the Preserve, except gas powered, trolling motors with 2.5 or less horse-power may be used on Horseshoe Lake and Red-Tail Lake.
RV Spaces do not allow for Toy Hauler, Truck Camper, and Pop Up Camper.

You are reservation is subject to cancellation and you will be asked to leave the community if the rules are not adhered to.

Any questions, please contact us directly prior to booking at 713-231-1100.

rulesList.name: Camping Etiquette
rulesList.content:
Whether you’re an experienced camper or planning your first outing, be sure you mind your manners at the campground. Camping etiquette is, for the most part, common courtesy. Here are a few suggestions on being a courteous camper:
Respect other’s rights. Don’t walk across another camper’s site – walk around it. Limit play of noisy games to the campground’s playground or recreation area.
Obey the campgrounds quiet hours. Voices, radios and other noises carry further than you might think on a quiet summer night. Quiet Hours are 10:00 pm- 8:00 am
Pack out what you pack in. A good rule is to leave your campsite cleaner than you found it.
Campground facilities exist for the benefit of all campers. Help keep them clean!
Black water should not be dumped in a lake, stream or on the ground.
Know and respect the campground’s rules, even if you don’t understand them all. Feel free to ask for explanation of any of them. The rules have been established to protect and respect the rights of campers, the campground and the environment.

rulesList.name: Woodsy Hollow Campground and RV Resort General Information
rulesList.content:
Do not drop cigarette butts on the ground. (Fire pits OK)
Speed Limit 9 1/2 MPH in the park
Licensed operators only for all motorized vehicles
Motorized vehicles prohibited on trails
Only golf carts are to be used
Quiet time 10:00 pm-8:00 am
Alcoholic beverages are permitted in the campground, if used responsibly. Management reserves the right to prohibit or restrict alcoholic beverages in the common areas. Alcohol, Maturity and Common Sense go hand in hand. Alcoholic beverages must be concealed (koozie) or in cups or non-glass cups
Sewer/Septic System. No rags, ashes, clothes, diapers or other improper artifice shall be placed into the sewer/septic system. Due to potential damages to the septic system, powdered soap must not be used. The cost of repairing clogs or damages caused by such improper conduct shall be the responsibility of the Guest and may be treated as an Additional Charge
Woodsy Hollow Campground and RV Resort has the right to refuse service to anyone and the right to remove any guest not following the rules from Woodsy Hollow. Any unused site credit will be forfeited.
*Consequences for not following these park rules will be an immediate removal from the park.

ATTENTION-PLEASE BE ADVISED: All rights granted to registered guests in Woodsy Hollow Campground and RV Resort is through a revocable license, which may be revoked at any time. Services are provided under a site services agreement. Under no circumstances should you consider yourself a tenant with a lease. Failure to make lot payments will be grounds for immediate removal from the park, and tenant may be subject to penalty under Texas penal code 31.04(B) Theft of Service.

rulesList.name: Swimming Pool Rules

ALL children under 13 must be accompanied by an adult
No Food inside swimming area
No diving
No running

No smoking inside pool area

rulesList.name: Sites/Site Request
rulesList.content:
We are happy to take requests for sites and do our best to honor them, however ALL sites are on a first come, first served best available basis, and at no time are site requests guaranteed. Do not change assigned site without office approval.
Each site rented includes 1 RV, 2 other vehicles and 4 people per site. Additional charges will apply for additional vehicles and people.

rulesList.name: Guests/Payments/Check In/Check Out
rulesList.content:
All who come to Woodsy Hollow Campground and RV Resort are considered guests. ALL guests / customers / visitors must check in at the office and pay the appropriate fees. Guests who do not check in will be asked to leave. There are no exceptions.
Check-in is no earlier than 11:00 am for RVs and Campers.
Check-out is no later than 4:00 pm on the date of departure. Later check-outs require an additional fee. (NO EXCEPTIONS)

Woodsy Hollow Campground and RV Resort has daily, weekly and extended stay rates available. Daily and weekly camping rates include water, sewer, wifi and electric. Extended stay (per month) rates include water, wifi and sewer, with electric being an additional actual metered charge (no additional charge for different amperage). *All extended stay sites require a $100.00 security deposit. Separate families sharing a site with a second camping unit on site, including tents, will be charged a separate site fee.

rulesList.name: Pet Policy
rulesList.content:
Woodsy Hollow Campground and RV Resort loves and accepts dogs. Pets are allowed in rooms/cabins with a $50.00 fee per pet. You as a dog owner are required to keep dogs on leashes and pick up after them. Aggressive dogs or dog breeds (such as Rottweilers, Pit Bulls etc.), are not allowed in park.
If you own a pet, keep it contained and clean up after it.
Don’t expect to tie your dog to a tree and leave him unattended. He will likely bark at strangers, dig holes and annoy your fellow campers.
Limit of 2 pets per site
Pets should never be left unattended outside your RV
All dogs must be on a leash at all times
Guests are responsible for promptly cleaning up after their pets
Management has the right to refuse any animal from being brought into the park and will ask you to remove any pet that causes a disturbance

rulesList.content: Please only park in designated Parking Areas. Parking on the Walking Path, Lawns, Landscaped Areas and empty RV Sites is PROHIBITED. Parking for Cabin rentals is at the main Entrance to the RV Park and parking on the RV Sites near the Cabins is STRICTLY Prohibited!

rulesList.name: Speed Limits
rulesList.content: Due to being located within a City Park, we ask that patrons respect the posted speed limits. The limit in the RV Park is 5 MPH!

rulesList.name: Quiet Hours
rulesList.content:
Quiet time is between the hours of 10pm and 6am.
NO generators, loud music or excessive noise that can be heard from a distance of 20 feet will be allowed.

rulesList.name: RV Spaces
rulesList.content:
Please keep camping sites neat and tidy. Do not hang laundry on fencing/vehicles.
There is a 2 vehicle limit per space. There is overflow parking for additional vehicles.
Never hook fresh water and septic flush up to a hydrant with a "Y" connection!!!

rulesList.name: Check IN/Check OUT
rulesList.content:
Check in for RV Spaces is at Noon - 8pm. Check in for Cabins will be from 2-8pm.
Check Out time will be 11 am for RV sites, and for cabins unless other accommodations have been made with the Camp Host.

rulesList.name: Washing Vehicles
rulesList.content: Use of RV Park water to wash vehicles or watercraft is PROHIBITED.

rulesList.name: Pets
rulesList.content: Dogs must be on a leash at ALL times in Scenic 6 Park, including at your RV camping site. NO continuous barking will be tolerated and may result in a citation or Eviction. All dog waste must be picked up. Scenic 6 Park provides several areas to get bags and dispose of waste.

rulesList.name: Camping Rules & Regulations
rulesList.content: 1 - Check-in times: 1:00 pm - 9:00 pm. After hours check in should be requested in advance.
2 - Check-out time: 11:00 a.m. Vacate by 11:00 a.m. to avoid another nightly charge.
3 - Occupy only the camp space you have paid for.
4 - Camping is only allowed in the designated campsite spaces within the Campground.
5 - Maximum Stay: 14 days within 30 days
6 - Firearms and Fireworks are prohibited, including airsoft, paintball, and other replicas.

7 - Fires must use propane and be contained in a metal container elevated at least 12 inches above the ground. A water source for extinguishing the fire must be readily available. The owner of the fire container must be present while the fire is in use. Charcoal and wood fires are strictly prohibited. All seasonal burn bans must be adhered to, and we reserve the right to prohibit any open flames during the dry season.
8 - Call 9-1-1 for emergencies and alert/inform the Campground Host after calling 9-1-1.

9 - AGE REQUIREMENT
Person registering for camping must be 18+ and be present during each night your are registered

Children 15 & under must be accompanied by an adult at all times.
10 - All vehicles, RVs and trailers (motorized or not) must be currently registered, licensed, insured, fully operational, in good working order, and movable at any time.
11 - Do not wash your vehicle, trailer or RV in the Campground or Fairgrounds.

rulesList.name: CAMPGROUND CONDUCT
rulesList.content:
• Quiet Hours: 9 p.m. – 8 a.m., seven (7) days a week.
Quiet time 9pm - 8am; no generators/loud activity during quiet hours. Be considerate of your neighbors, area visitors, and other users
- No UAVs (drones)
- No firearms
- No fireworks
- No ATVs/dirtbikes/minibikes, or any other unmuffled small engines. Prolonged noises above 70 dB are prohibited.
• Alcohol consumption is permitted only at your campsite space. The law forbids open containers of alcohol in public spaces. No walking around consuming alcohol.
• Behavior which disturbs or creates a nuisance for others in the Campground or in the vicinity of Fairgrounds property is prohibited. Call 9-1-1 if issues persist.
• No smoking allowed on Fairgrounds and Campground property. Smoking is permitted in your vehicle, trailer or tent only.
• You must maintain a clean and orderly campsite - no clutter, garbage and personal belongings scattered about. Clothes lines are prohibited.

rulesList.name: Maximum Occupancy & Party Size per Campsite Space
rulesList.content: • Two vehicles and one RV/Trailer per space
• Two vehicles and two small to medium-sized tents per space

• Two vehicles and one large to extra large-sized tent per space
Maximum of six (6) people per campsite space per overnight stay

rulesList.name: Restroom/Shower Facilities
rulesList.content:
• Restrooms/showers are available for all paying campers. After registering and paying, access codes
will be sent to you before your stay. Showers and bathrooms are ADA accessible.

rulesList.name: Garbage Disposal
rulesList.content:
• Garbage cans are available for campers during their overnight stay to deposit trash generated during their stay. No dumping of large quantities
of trash; penalty will result in a $150 fine and/or eviction from Fairgrounds and Campground
property. No exceptions.

rulesList.name: Sewage/Gray Water Dump Disposal
rulesList.content:
• The sewage/gray water Dump Station is on the southwest side of the Campgrounds. Gray
water/sewage dumping anywhere else is prohibited, from a holding tank, containers, or hose.

• Persons urinating/defecating outside anywhere on Fairgrounds and Campground property is
against the law. Violation of any of these laws will result in immediate eviction from the property,
possible fines and Trespassing Admonishment from Langley Police may occur.

rulesList.name: Pet Control
rulesList.content:
• Pets must be on a leash at all times; leash should not be longer than eight feet and owner must be
in control of the pet at all times. Pet fencing within your campsite is allowed to control your pet. Pet
owners are responsible to clean up pet waste and dispose of properly in garbage cans.

Horse owners MUST provide stall mats to prevent damage to the ground from digging. All feed, manure, and hay must be contained and cleaned up thoroughly.

• Pets shall not be left unattended outside at any time. Do not tie pet outside of your RV when you
are not present. No ground tie-downs permitted.

• If any pet demonstrates aggressive behavior toward another pet or camper, you will be asked to
leave the campground with no refunds. No excessive barking allowed.

rulesList.name: Unattended Property
rulesList.content:
• Vehicles, Trailers, RVs, or any other personal property that appears unattended will be considered
abandoned and towed/impounded at the owner’s expense.

rulesList.name: Please respect these rules so everyone is safe and can enjoy their stay.  Thank you!

Water Canyon RV Park is privately owned. We reserve the right to refuse service to anyone and will not be responsible, financial or otherwise, for accident or injury to guests or for loss of money or valuables of any kind.
Please note our cancellation policy: Cancellations 1 day are fully refundable. Less than 1 day will be charged full price.

Pet owners assume full responsibility, financial or otherwise, for all injuries and/or damage caused by their pet. Cleaning up after pet is owners’ responsibility.
Guests will assume financial responsibility for any and all damages they cause.
All guests agree to read and comply with all Water Canyon RV Parks Rules and Regulations. Upon signing this registration form, I acknowledge receipt of a copy of the Rules and Regulations, agree to follow them and hold Water Canyon RV Park harmless of any and all accidents, injuries, losses, and damages of any sort or kind, even death.

Site Selection Disclaimer

While every effort is made to accommodate site selection, we reserve the right to reassign sites if the situation should warrant.

rulesList.name: Vehicle & Bike
rulesList.content: * A 15KM maximum speed limit within the park.

* Two licensed and insured vehicles are allowed on each site for seasonal campers but must make room on your campsite to accommodate the second vehicle. No parking on the side of or on campground roads, or grass areas. The second one can park at parking lot without additional cost.
* Only one registered vehicle per camp site for overnight campers. Additional parking available in parking lot with a cost of $10 for the duration of your stay.
* No other type of vehicle is allowed.
* Bike riding permitted on camp road only.
* No bike riding after dark.
* No freight trucks, CUB vans.

rulesList.name: Quiet Hours
rulesList.content: * Quiet time is from 11:00 p.m. to 9:00 a.m. as per North Bay By-Law.
* The radio and music must be turned off and voices lowered at 11:00 p.m.
* Please respect the rights of others.
* Any disturbance should be reported to the office.

rulesList.name: Pets
rulesList.content: * Pets are welcome but must keep quiet, gentle to be considerate of others.
* All pets entering the park must be up to date on vaccinations.
* All pets must be tied, contained or leashed (no longer than 2 meters) at all times.
* Pets, their excrement and any damage are the responsibility of the owner.
* Pets are not to be left alone.
* Clean up after your pet & dispose of litter in a plastic bag.

rulesList.name: Children
rulesList.content: * Parents are responsible for the supervision of their children at all times.
* All children under the age of 18 must be on their own campsite at 11:00 p.m. or with their supervising adult.
* No one under 18 years of age is allowed to stay in the park without supervision.

rulesList.name: Campfires
rulesList.content: * Campfires must be completely out by 11:00 p.m.
* Campfires are not permitted between 10am and 7pm unless for cooking purposes only.
* Campfires are to be contained in the approved fire ring and maintained as per North Bay By-Law 2015-115 & 2022-17.
* Campfires must be extinguished completely before leaving campsite or going to bed.
* Only local firewood to be used.
* You are responsible for the safety of your family, friends, or other guests attending your campfire on your campsite.
* Fireworks are not permitted in the park.

rulesList.name: Occupancy
rulesList.content: * Site are rented to one family, 2 adults and their children under the age of 18.

rulesList.name: Occupancy
rulesList.content: * Site are rented to one family, 2 adults and their children under the age of 18.
* Based on 4 persons occupancy per site, up to 2 additional persons with fees .
* Only one camping unit per site, absolutely no pop-up tents allowed in addition to main camping unit.
* All visitors must be registered at the office and pay fees if stay over 3 hours before going to the site. Occupant must be present on site.
* Visitor parking is beside the office.
* All visitors must leave the campground by 11p.m.
* No visitors allowed to overnight unless approved by park management team.
* Park management team reserves the right to limit the number of visitors attending.

rulesList.name: Swimming Pool
rulesList.content: * No Lifeguard on duty.
* Children under the age of 14 must be accompanied by an adult.
* The swimming pool is open from 9a.m. to 8 p.m.
* Proper bathing suits must be worn in the pool.
* Not swimming alone.
* No diving in pool.
* No alcohol in public areas.
* Sign up at the entrance.
* Pool rules and Regulations are posted at the pool.
* Pool use is for registered guests.
* Only water in plastic containers is allowed on the pool.

rulesList.name: Garbage
rulesList.content: * Household Garbage is to be placed in plastic bags and deposited in the dumpster provided on Marina Drive.
* Recycling is encouraged.
* All other garbage must be disposed of in the municipal landfill.

rulesList.name: Others
rulesList.content: * Alcohol, Marijuana and Cigarette smoking must be kept on your campsite by Provincial Law and Park Rule.
* Illegal activities of any kind will result in park eviction and/or appropriate police action.
* Generators are not permitted at any time.

rulesList.name: Cottages Extra Vehicles Policy
rulesList.content: 1 extra vehicle can be selected with your reservation. We might have space for more vehicles for $20 per night. Please contact us for approval.
